# Radoslav Radev Recommends Greasing The Groove Method For Planche With 10 Attempts Spread Across The Day, One Two Times Per Week

Radoslav Radev recommends the greasing the groove method for planche training: separate 10 attempts during the whole day instead of doing five attempts and losing strength. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:30]

## Details

- Most people train wrong by doing five attempts that are their maximum strength, and after the second attempt they are already tired. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:18]
- Instead of doing five attempts and losing strength and doing lower progressions, separate 10 attempts during the whole day. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:30]
- Doing maximum hold and lower and lower progression until you can do push-ups is not the most efficient way. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:41]
- His advice is to do it one two times per week. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:00]
- If you work i.t if your home office, you can do it every day. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:00]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:18 (Radoslav Radev): "in the beginning of the workout let's say you have five attempts that that's your maximum strength you have five attempts that in these five attempts you have to progress but let's say you're doing the first you're doing the second attempt and after the second you're already tired"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:30 (Radoslav Radev): "the method that i want to tell you is greasing the groove method. Try to separate 10 attempts during the whole day."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 05:41 (Radoslav Radev): "Instead of doing five attempts and after that losing your strength and doing lower progressions, this is really dumb, guys. I mean, maximum hold and lower and lower progression until you can do push-ups, it's not smart."
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 06:00 (Radoslav Radev): "my advice for you is to do it one two times per week it's good if you can do it every day if you work i.t if your home office"
